name: Status
purpose: Shows the state of something with a deadline or a validity, such as a vehicle's tax or MOT, or a driving licence: an icon for its state, then what it is and how it stands, such as Valid, 23 days, or Expired.

origin.notes: From the future driving designs in Figma, which we have only as a screenshot for now, so its sizes are approximate: the app today shows tax and MOT with ValidityStatusView, its icon on the right and a progress bar below. The colours are GovKit's: primaryGreen for valid, accentPurple for due, on the app's pale blue. The designs show only light mode, so the dark mode colours are ours.

state.description: valid: a green dot. due: a purple ring, filled as far as progress, for something coming up. expired: a circled exclamation mark. none: no icon, for something that doesn't apply, such as an MOT that isn't required.

progress.description: For a due status, how full its ring is, from 0 to 1, such as 0.75. Make it the share of the time left, so it empties as the deadline nears.

label.description: What it is, in bold, such as Tax, MOT due or Tax expiring.

detail.description: Anything to say after the label on the same line, not in bold, such as a date: 12 May 2026.

caption.description: The line below, in grey, such as Valid, 23 days, Expired or Not required.

rules: Say the state in words as well, in the caption or the label: the icon alone doesn't tell everyone, such as people who can't see it or can't tell its colours apart.
Use due for something with a deadline coming up, and count down to it in the caption, such as 23 days. Give it a progress to match.
Use none, not valid, for something that doesn't apply, and say so: Not required.
Keep the label to a word or two, and the caption to one short line, so two fit side by side.

ios.symbol: ValidityStatusView, which this replaces in the future designs

examples.name: Due, counting down
examples.html: <govuk-app-status state="due" progress="0.75" label="MOT due" caption="23 days"></govuk-app-status>

examples.name: With a date
examples.html: <govuk-app-status state="due" progress="0.6" label="Tax expiring" detail="12 May 2026" caption="18 days"></govuk-app-status>
